ecl.text: Tamira, called Tam, is on a Strixhaven class trip collecting samples in the Harrier's Wood when a faerie lures her and three classmates through a hole into a meadow where a single sun tells them they are not on Arcavios.

They step through a dolmen gate into the dark and find a sleeping moon-headed creature, and when it wakes they flee the spreading night until the archer Brigid Baeli leads them into an ash forest and tells them that people tumble into Lorwyn since the metal invasion.
Tam and Sanar reach Queen Maralen through a waterfall, and Maralen tells them Oona is returning and she does not know if she can stop her, before fleeing with them.

Tam is shot in the abdomen with an arrow, and Ajani heals her wound, then Eirdu's breath flares the dawnglow in it so that she wakes and embraces Sanar. Ajani later leads the group through an Omenpath back toward Arcavios.
